covered.title: Sales Connect Widgets — Launching Week of June 8
covered.summary: Payroll SS flow pages will surface customer CTAs like “Call me now” and “Schedule a call”; “X rep is calling you” alerts are coming to the in-app experience. Team rollout/launch training is Tues, June 9.

covered.title: Designbase Theme Refresh — Updated App Visual System

covered.title: Hiring V1 → V2 Migration Reminder
covered.summary: June 3 reminder email nudges remaining V1 Hiring customers toward Hiring Assistant, with a goal of no remaining V1 users by July 14.
